headline.purpose: Page titles (2.25rem from 640px) and section headings; result headings at 1.5rem.

title.purpose: Dialog, step, plan card (1.125rem) and advice section headings.

body.purpose: Running text; AI advice at 1.65 leading, 70ch.

lead.purpose: One line of muted subcopy under a headline.

control.purpose: Buttons, nav links, menu items, field text.

label.purpose: Field labels in ink; meal types and captions in muted. Sentence case.

figure.purpose: Headline numbers in tabular figures, unit in muted 600.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Every resting panel and the active tab.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, menus, select lists, toasts; paired with a 1px rule ring on menus and toasts.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklab, #2f9e6e 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for draws, rises, settles and control transitions.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Route strokes draw in; the hero path runs once on mount via the Web Animations API with the drawn line as its resting state.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Panels, list items and floating layers entering; staggered 70-110ms.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Hero stations settling after the line, 220ms stagger; no fade from invisible.

motion.name: grow
motion.purpose: Vertical route segments and target-range segments.

motion.name: travel
motion.purpose: Amber marker crossing the progress track while the AI works.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button and field colour and shadow transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animations off; routes drawn, marker parked at 50%

narrative.overview:
A day of eating drawn as a transit line. Meals are stations on one green route, so a person always sees where they are and what comes next. Every surface is built from one mark, the station: a white dot with a thick near-black ring, joined to the next by a rounded green stroke. The destination stop is filled amber. The rest of the system stays out of the way: a warm off-white ground, white rounded panels, near-black type, plain literal labels.

The world is calm and light by decision. It is used in short daylight sessions at a desk or kitchen counter, so there is no dark theme and no atmospheric effects. Density is low and generous: large rounded panels, 48px fields, pill buttons. Two inks carry everything at rest (ink and muted on ground and panel); colour appears only when it means something, and every coloured state is also written in words.

Motion follows the line. Routes draw themselves in, stops settle into place, and while the AI works a marker travels the track with an elapsed-seconds count. Every animation starts from a visible resting state, and reduced motion shows the drawn result.
keyCharacteristics: One mark, the ringed station dot, reused at every scale from the logo to the hero map.
Two inks at rest; green, orange, blue and amber appear only as state.
Rounded everything: pill controls, 14px fields, 24px panels, round caps and joins on every line.
Single variable sans (Overpass) at bold weights for headings, tabular figures for every number.
Soft, low ambient shadows lift panels off the ground; no borders around panels.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: At rest a screen is ink and muted on ground and panel. Colour is spent only on the route and on state; if a coloured element doesn't mean something, it goes back to ink.

rules.name: The Colour Plus Words Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by colour alone. Over and under plans recolour their line and also carry an "Over goal" or "Under goal" label; success and error toasts carry an icon and a sentence.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber marks the destination: one stop per line. A second amber element on the same route means the line has two ends.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every calorie, gram and second count uses tabular numerals so stops line up down a route.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case and literal ("Daily calorie goal", "Show portions"). No uppercase tracked labels, no eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Depth is ambient and diffuse, tinted with ink, never a hard offset. Two levels only: resting panel and floating layer.

dos: **Do** build new visuals from the station and the line: ringed dots joined by rounded green strokes, last stop amber.
**Do** keep screens to two inks at rest and spend colour only on state, always with words beside it.
**Do** use pill shapes for every pressable control and 24px radius for panels.
**Do** set every number in tabular figures and put units in muted type.
**Do** start motion from a visible resting state: draw routes and rise stops over 300 to 1100ms on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and show the drawn result under reduced motion.
**Do** end each route segment at its last station.
donts: **Don't** add eyebrows or uppercase tracked labels above headings.
**Don't** use Route Green as body text on light grounds; use Route Ink.
**Don't** use amber for anything but the destination or active stop.
**Don't** show a state by colour alone.
**Don't** put borders around panels or use hard offset shadows; lift with the two ambient shadows.
**Don't** introduce a dark theme or a second typeface.
**Don't** let an animation start from an empty or invisible state that a capture or restored page could freeze on.
